links.comparator_used: Pre-implementation period without the VizAI smartphone application (usual notification of the neurosurgical team)
links.outcome: Time from CT head to notification of the neurosurgical team for ENRICH trial screening
links.effect: Reduced by 50 minutes after VizAI implementation (p<0.002); 57 minutes when hemorrhages not identified by the ICH algorithm were excluded
links.quote: Time between CT Head and notification of the neurosurgical team for trial screening was reduced by 50 minutes after the implementation of VizAI (p<0.002).
